context: Four fixed five-second contexts, not an independent recording or a full endpoint. See subsequent priority-status correction in prestart history.

checks: All original data, recipe, historical report, historical provenance and proxy file hashes match the frozen plan.
Candidate and installed source hashes match their recorded bindings.
Result references the unchanged frozen plan, preparation receipt, regression gate and execution script.
All four per-case JSON records exactly match the corresponding result entries.
Selected sample bounds, labels, original proxy flags and historical window seeds match the frozen plan; all selected samples satisfy the original evaluation mask.
Historical target/spline/Zuna array slices and corrected target/spline array slices exactly match their original saved source arrays.

Per-case corrected theta/alpha/beta Welch band powers independently recomputed without concatenating disjoint contexts match JSON within tolerance.

record.interpretation: The short predetermined selection already favored Zuna before correction. The result does not show that the boundary correction creates a model advantage or reverses the full-recording outcome. Historical and corrected prepared targets differ. Four windows from two blocks are not independent validation.
record.nonblocking_reporting_note: Pooled NMSE uses each electrode's variance across the pooled 20 seconds, not the average of four context-specific NMSE scores; clarify this if readers compare table rows.
